review_items.rationale: Reviewed artifact 9050f0c543c046d98f7220703a46ed84 version 1, fixed plan and byte-identical assurance_generated_test.go, and execution e94f713eff47485582d7004dd190b24e with its monitor_result and raw CA_EVENT outputs. Applicability: ReadOnlySafe explicitly promises quorum-based linearizable read authority. The singleton shortcut may replace a quorum round only when its local node constitutes that quorum; learner membership cannot supply the sole voter support. StepDownOnRemoval=false changes role transition, not that read obligation. The selected node remains a learner, so this does not depend on a removed-node host shutdown policy. Entry and history: public NewRawNode starts two peers from an explicit common snapshot at index 1; Campaign, generated messages, persistence-delayed self/peer replies and ProposeConfChange produce actual election and commitment. Changer.Simple legally demotes one voter. Both configuration_applied events report voters=[2], learners=[1], index=3. Host stores all Ready entries/HardState, applies committed entries in strict index order with ApplyConfChange, and only then Advances and delivers queued messages. No early Advance, role mutation, fabricated acknowledgment, lease or dropped local storage completion is used. Isolation begins only after both configurations are installed; actual voter 2 campaigns, persists and commits its term-3 no-op and normal write at index 5. Correlation: admission_alias explicitly names read_admitted, with independent run/node/fresh RequestCtx identity shared by the result. Results are emitted from every Ready.ReadState without expected-outcome filtering; membership is read independently from Status.Config, not from IsSingleton. Both operations have one result and a bounded quiescence-close event. The zero incoming-message antecedent is supported by the deterministic network driver, counters, unique fresh contexts, no prior read requests and partition; no pending old read/quorum support can satisfy this request. Oracle: result-emitted with no post-admission quorum message implies local-is-sole-voter; this is a necessary support eligibility condition, not a requirement that a read complete. Actual learner result at read index 3 has local_is_sole_voter=false and incoming_since_admission=0, so it violates the claim. The same-history voter control returns index 5 with local_is_sole_voter=true and no incoming messages, corroborating the permitted shortcut case. The fixed monitor evaluates both, with complete unique correlations and no parsing errors. Source dispatch connects the learner StateLeader to the cardinality-only shortcut, supporting the proposed local cause; no global client endpoint is attributed. Explained alternatives and boundaries: StepDownOnRemoval=true would prevent retaining the learner leader role; this alternate configuration is outside the checked false setting. Non-singleton ReadOnlySafe uses actual voter heartbeat acknowledgments and is not shown defective by this check. The returned index/value diagnostics show stale local state relative to the new write, but the driver does not execute a client read-barrier consumption API; no broader linearizability verdict is claimed.
review_items.report_title: 降级为 learner 的旧领导者仍通过单节点读捷径
review_items.report_answer: 在 StepDownOnRemoval=false、ReadOnlySafe 模式下，双方已应用降级配置后，旧领导者作为 learner 在未收到任何读期间消息的情况下返回索引 3；唯一投票节点已应用索引 5 的新写入。该结果违反本次检查的单节点读支持资格要求；尚未据此认定客户端线性一致性端点违规。
